PROCEDURE FOR REVIEW OF NOTICES OF INTENT FOR HIGHWAY PROJECTS
Using EPA Screening Procedure Provided in 'Guidelines for Air Quality Maintenance Planning and Analysis Volume 9: Evaluating Indirect Sources, January 1975
PHV—Peak hour volume for the year, vehicles per hour. If higher traffic volumes are expected during the warm summer months, the highest hour during the months of Jan. through April and Nov. through Dec. may be used.
b When traffic for the "no build" alternative is not zero, project caused degradation is the "build" concentration minus the "no build" concentration.
p—EPA meteorological persistence factor. CO concentration determined by using average vehicles per hour during the highest consecutive 8 hours of traffic for the year (or the highest 8 hours during Jan. through April and Nov. through Dec.) is multiplied by this factor, assumed equal to 0.6 in the absence of data for the DNR NOV. To particular project location.
